phen.effect: air that expands gets very cold

refrigerated-transport.flag: Left Refrigerators off as a slot: the Bell-Coleman machine is a cold-air machine, not the ammonia refrigerator on that card, so its compressor and steam engine are listed instead. Insulated hold has no card and isn't shared.

phen.effect: the treads grip the soil instead of slipping

tractor.flag: Own job: 'provides power' (it replaces the horse team, like Horse collar). Friction link is borderline under rule 28; drop if it reads as a general law. Gear advantage is left to Gear train (rule 23).

phen.effect: a liquid soaks up heat as it evaporates and gives it up as it condenses
squeezing the vapour heats it

air-conditioning.flag: No 'cools' job on the list; 'carries heat' is what it does (pumps heat out of the building). Latent heat is kept on the whole because the filler, Liquid ammonia, carries no effect; Freon (later) has latent heat itself, so if Freon became the filler this link would move to it (rule 23).

phen.effect: spinning flings the water out of the cloth

washing-machine.flag: NEW JOB 'cleans': washing machine, dishwasher, vacuum cleaner (and arguably sewage treatment, water chlorination) would use it; 'cleans exhaust' is too narrow. Drum and detergent have no card; detergent is shared only with the dishwasher, so left off.

phen.effect: a counterweight balances the load across the mast

tower-crane.flag: No 'lifts loads' job; 'transports' as for Elevators. Concrete counterweight left off (job would be 'balances', not on the list).

slots.note: key part, no card

phen.effect: plaster sets hard as its crystals regrow with water
water locked in the crystals boils off and soaks up the fire's heat

drywall.flag: Hydration gap is the same one Portland cement already names. Latent heat is a stand-in for the fire-resistance effect (it is really dehydration of the crystals then boiling); drop if too loose.

phen.effect: a stretched cable pulls back and keeps the concrete squeezed

prestressed-concrete.flag: Jobs follow Reinforced concrete's precedent. Reinforced concrete itself not a slot (rule 6: same material refined). Concrete being strong in compression is a material property (rule 28), left off.

slots.note: key part, no card: stops clotting by taking up calcium

phen.effect: the body attacks blood of the wrong type

blood-bank.flag: 'preserves food' is the nearest job for keeping blood cold; suggest broadening it to 'preserves' (blood bank, frozen food). Tissue transplantation is a stand-in for blood groups (rule 9, the only card for rejection); a 'Blood groups' card would be better. Clotting needing calcium is folded into the citrate gap.

slots.note: added later: the first (V-1) used a pulsejet; the Jet engine key-part gap on Jet planes is the same part
later models

cruise-missile.flag: Own job 'explodes' following V-2. Terrain-matching radar left off (later models only). No effect at its own level: lift, thrust and gyroscopic stiffness all sit with parts.

phen.effect: fibres wick liquid away from the skin

disposable-diaper.flag: No 'absorbs' job; 'holds the contents' is nearest. Superabsorbent gel is a later addition with no card, left off.

hearing-aid.flag: Own job follows Cochlear implant. No effect at its own level; all sit with the parts.

phen.effect: electrons hitting metal make X-rays
radiation damages the cells it passes through

radiotherapy.flag: X-ray production kept on the whole: Tungsten gets no effect of its own (rule 24, it also serves as filament). Shaping the beam from many angles has no card.

transistor-radio.flag: Radio isn't a slot (rule 6: the same thing made small). Superheterodyne receiver left off: the TR-1 used its circuit design, but that is a borrowed idea (rule 5), and that card's own amplifier is the triode. Antenna job 'radiates waves' is the board's job for antennas, though here it receives.

phen.effect: the warhead coasts down a free-fall arc

intercontinental-ballistic-missile.flag: Ballistic coast linked to Universal gravitation as 'orbit' is for satellites; drop if it reads as a general law (rule 28). Guidance computer not in the text, left off.

slots.note: key part, no card

phen.effect: coiled chains stretch and spring back

spandex.flag: Hooke's law (elasticity) is a stand-in for rubber-like elasticity of coiled chains; it is the board's elasticity card.

phen.effect: the pressure of the drink inside stiffens the thin walls

aluminium-drink-can.flag: How it's pressed and ironed is production (rule 4). Chilling quickly is a material property (rule 28).

slots.note: key part, no card: bred in from Japanese wheat and Taiwanese rice

phen.effect: the plant ignores part of a growth hormone's signal, so stalks stay short

high-yield-dwarf-wheat-and-rice.flag: Fertilizer is what it's grown with (rule 4), not a part. Wheat/rice themselves have no card.

phen.effect: adrenaline speeds the heart by fitting receptors that a drug can block

beta-blockers.flag: No ingredient has a card. Possible shared effect gap 'Drug receptors' (a drug fits a cell's receptor, switching it on or blocking it): Beta blockers, GLP-1 drugs, SSRIs, and on the board Morphine (currently Endorphins). Used Hormones as the stand-in here.

slots.note: key part, no card (microchannel plate); photomultiplier tubes share it
same gap as Oscilloscope's key part

night-vision-goggles.flag: Own job follows Thermal camera. Photoelectric effect sits with Photocell (rule 23); electron multiplication and phosphor glow belong to the two gap parts' future cards. 'Phosphor screen' is already a key-part gap on Oscilloscope; 'Electron multiplier' would also serve photomultipliers and PET scanner detectors.

phen.effect: tumours and calcium specks absorb more X-rays than soft tissue

mammography.flag: Film/detector left off: no card states X-ray film directly.

slots.note: close stand-in: the only steering-surface card
later kinds

precision-guided-bombs.flag: Rudder as a stand-in for the steering fins is a judgement call (rule 9); drop if too loose. Explosive filling has no card. No own-level effect.

video-game-console.flag: No 'plays games' job; 'computes' is nearest broad own job (uncertain: the first console had no processor). TV counted as a part since the console only works through it (like GPS's satellites). Controller knob has no card. Line-by-line scanning is the TV's working, not a new effect at this level.

slots.note: shared: Airbag, Smartphone (tilt sensor), Quadcopter drone, Intercontinental ballistic missile guidance
key part, no card

airbag.flag: NEW GAP 'Accelerometer' (a mass on a spring or in a chip that senses sudden speed changes): 3+ new cards share it. Its effect (a mass keeps moving when the car stops: Laws of motion) belongs on that card, so none on the airbag itself.

slots.note: added later: the 1975 prototype recorded to cassette tape

digital-camera.flag: Camera isn't a slot (rule 6, same thing made digital). Photoelectric effect sits with the CCD (rule 23).

slots.note: later models
the board's cathode-ray display card

personal-computer.flag: Six slots, all named in its text; mouse could be dropped (1977 machines had none). Binary and logic sit with Microchips.

slots.note: shared: Portable music player, Video tape recorder, and magnetic stripes on Credit card and ATM cards
later players

phen.effect: the moving magnetised tape makes a current in the playback head

portable-music-player.flag: Possible shared gap 'Magnetic tape' (or a broader 'Magnetic recording' medium card); tape keeping its magnetism (Magnetic hysteresis) would go on that card.

phen.effect: music stored as binary numbers

compact-disc.flag: Laser disks isn't a slot (rule 6, same technique). Error-correcting check numbers are maths the job carries out (rule 22) but have no card and aren't shared by 3, left off.

slots.note: key part, no card

phen.effect: radar bounces off flat panels like light off a tilted mirror

stealth-aircraft.flag: Radio waves card used because it shows radio waves reflect like light; Optics only states curved mirrors focusing.

slots.note: key part, no card

3d-printing.flag: Liquid hardening under ultraviolet light (photopolymerization) belongs on the resin gap's future card, so no effect at this level. Platform lift motor not named in text.

keyhole-surgery.flag: 'pushes' for the insufflation gas is a stretch; no 'inflates' job. Surgery isn't a slot (rule 6, same practice done differently). Total internal reflection sits with Fiber optics.

phen.effect: ultraviolet pulses snap the bonds in a thin layer of tissue
reshaping the cornea's curve moves the eye's focus

laser-eye-surgery.flag: Refraction is the eye's own focusing that the practice works with (rule 25).

phen.effect: sound is split into narrow bands of pitch
a quiet sound next to a louder one can't be heard

compressed-media.flag: Auditory masking is the key effect with no card (rule 16 exception); the matching visual effect (the eye won't miss fine detail) is folded into it. Own job uncertain: 'records media' is nearest, though it also serves 'communicates'.

military-drones.flag: Engine and propeller not in its text, left off. Airplane isn't a slot (rule 6). Lift sits with Wing.

mars-rovers.flag: Own job follows Skylab and Space station (it studies rocks). Rocker-bogie suspension has no card and isn't shared; left off (could be its key part). Radio delay is why it steers itself, not an effect it works by.

slots.note: early hybrids used nickel-metal hydride cells, which have no card

phen.effect: braking turns the motor into a generator that charges the battery

hybrid-car.flag: Regenerative braking kept on the whole: Electric motors' own effect is the motor effect, not induction (rule 23 allows a different effect of the same card). Automobile isn't a slot (rule 6).

search-engine.flag: NEW JOB 'finds information': Search engine, Voice assistant, Large language models (and arguably World Wide Web). World Wide Web isn't a slot: it's what the technique is used on (rule 8). Link-based ranking is an algorithm with no card; left off (technique, rule 21).

short-range-wireless-link.flag: Frequency hopping is a technique (rule 21), not an effect; radio waves sit with Radio antennas (rule 23).

phen.effect: a gut hormone tells the pancreas to release insulin and the brain that you are full

glp-1-drugs.flag: Own job follows Oral contraceptives and Oxytocin synthesis. No ingredient has a card. See Beta blockers flag on a possible 'Drug receptors' card.

mobile-money.flag: NEW JOB 'pays': Mobile payments, Credit card, ATM cash machine, Online shopping (Coin currently 'measures'). Text messaging and shop agents have no card.

slots.note: added later: 2011 recognisers used older statistical models

voice-assistants.flag: New job 'finds information' (see Search engine). Speech synthesiser has no card. Could instead take Smartphone as its device, but its microphone and speaker are listed directly.

slots.note: key part, no card

reusable-rocket-booster.flag: Landing legs also lack a card; kept only one key part. Reaction thrust sits with Liquid-fuel rockets.

slots.note: key part, no card: steers its beam electronically

satellite-internet-constellations.flag: Beam steering by adding waves from many small antennas (Light waves, interference) would go on the phased-array card. Orbit sits with Communications satellites.
